data.title: Desktop: Tauri wrap + Actions release pipeline + download links

data.body: Implemented: (1) src-tauri/ tauri v2 scaffold — minimal (no plugins, core:default capability only), productName pattern-maker, window title 'pattern maker PM–1' 1440x900 min 900x640, version 0.1.0 aligned with package.json; (2) icon set from a 1024px PM-1 mark (16px favicon geometry x64, transparent AA rounded corners r=224) rendered by a zero-dep scratchpad PNG encoder, emitted via npx tauri icon; (3) .github/workflows/release.yml — tauri-action@v0, tag v*, mac aarch64+x86_64 / ubuntu-22.04 / windows matrix, contents:write, rust-cache; (4) masthead 'desktop ↓' link to releases/latest, label-gray mono, hover ink, hidden via __TAURI_INTERNALS__ guard; (5) gitignore src-tauri/target + gen. Verified: cargo check green (38s), npx tsc --noEmit + npm run build green, actionlint + ruby YAML parse clean on release.yml, npx tauri info parses config, 1024px and 32px icons visually confirmed (badge/grid/orange LED read). Deviations: deleted CLI-emitted android/ + ios/ icon dirs (desktop-only app); kept the Windows Square*Logo pngs the CLI emits. Committed Cargo.lock (application convention). Not done here per orchestrator: no push, no v0.1.0 tag. Commits 409e8f1, 7635b4d, 78fe67a.
